project_type: Next.js 16.2.4 App Router community educational website
build_system: npm with Next.js built-in bundler (Turbopack in dev). Node.js 22+ required. Node path: /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.1/bin
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build and ensure all pages compile without errors. 2. Run npm run lint and ensure no ESLint errors.
environment_constraints: Node.js available via nvm at /root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.1/bin. Network mode: OPEN_INTERNET. AGENTS.md warns: 'This is NOT the Next.js you know. Read the relevant guide in node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before writing any code.'
contribution_requirements: Use responsive Tailwind CSS utility classes. Use Semantic HTML for all layout sections. Must follow AGENTS.md guidance to consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ for Next.js 16 APIs.
key_patterns: Client components use 'use client' directive. Pages export metadata objects. Content components follow pattern: FooContent.tsx in app/components/ with Framer Motion animations. CSS uses Tailwind v4 with @theme inline directive and CSS custom properties. Dark-first theme with .light class toggle.
directory_structure: app/ - Next.js App Router pages and components. app/components/ - 14 shared React components. docs/ - PRD documentation. public/ - static assets. All pages are static or SSG.
